title: T4OffLK landed: the 0259 pin as a RANGE theorem - wallLo(N) > own at EVERY run N in [nIdeal, 2 nIdeal] (previously only the single run Noff = ceil nIdeal was a landed statement), and the S3 face is infeasible THROUGHOUT the range (s3faceInfeasiblePinRange = T4OffLJ's weak-pin face death applied to the range pin via the S4 strict gap; no pin premise at the corollary level). The face-infeasibility record now covers an interval of runs, extending 0262/0266 from discrete points to the first in-body range.

artifacts.t4LK_pinRange: THE 0259 RANGE PIN: on the band (1000 <= t, 1/200 <= d0 < 1/2), at every run N in [nIdeal(t,d0), 2 nIdeal(t,d0)] (N > 0), wallLo(t, d0, N) > ‖poff t d0 t‖. Proof = T4OffLF.pin with Noff replaced by the free N: the T1 chain uses the range upper bound N <= 2 nIdeal in place of the ceiling fact Noff <= 2 nIdeal (giving (1/2)N^{-(1/2-d0)} >= (4 d0^2 / t^2) * 2^{1/2+d0}, the same closed constant), and the T2/T3 caps (T4OffLF.t2cap / t3cap under nIdeal <= N) were already free in N; the t5strict gap + ownCap close as in the 0259 pin. No RH claim.
artifacts.t4LK_s3faceInfeasiblePinRange: S3-FACE INFEASIBILITY ON THE 0259 RANGE: on the band, at every run N in [nIdeal, 2 nIdeal], the A2c-exact fill is strictly above the wire: ‖p4_em_expr (t4l_sOffL t d0) N‖ > BwireR(t,d0) + MrR(t,d0). Derivation: range pin (S1) + t4LE_flo_eq_own (flo = own) + s4StripUnifiedFloor with MfR = 0 (the S4 strict gap own > wire) => the weak pin wallLo(N) > wire => T4OffLJ.s3faceDeadWeakPin (0266). No pin premise, no bridge premise at the corollary level - the whole chain is in body. No RH claim.

content.what_completed: T4OffLK (formal/RhAttack/T4OffLK.lean, 2 theorems): (1) pinRange - the generalized 0259 pin: wallLo(N) > own for every N in the coarse range [nIdeal, 2 nIdeal], a direct port of T4OffLF.pin where the single Noff-specific ceiling fact (Noff <= 2 nIdeal) is replaced by the range hypothesis and t2cap/t3cap (already free in N under nIdeal <= N) supply the T2/T3 caps. (2) s3faceInfeasiblePinRange - composition: range pin + flo = own + S4 gap => weak pin => T4OffLJ's weak-pin face-death atom => the S3 face is infeasible at every run of the range. This is the first in-body FACE-INFEASIBILITY OVER A RANGE of runs: 0262/0266 proved face infeasibility at discrete runs (pin range points / every point via the weak-pin atom applied premise-wise); 0267 lands the range as a single statement with no external running of the argument.
content.why_it_matters: The 0266 weak-pin atom (T4OffLJ S1) proved face infeasibility at any run satisfying wallLo(N) > wire - a pointwise conditional. 0267 makes the antecedent an in-body theorem on a genuine INTERVAL [nIdeal, 2 nIdeal], so the S3 face is infeasible on the whole 0259 coarse window without any per-run argument. Combined with day065's map (the S3-impossible region N < N1 covers the pin region, and N1/N2 margins are total at 36/36 band points), the exhaustion record is now: discrete (0262: pinned runs) + pointwise conditional (0266: weak pin) + interval theorem (0267: [nIdeal, 2 nIdeal]) - with the named next fire being the wire-crossing extension (wallLo(N) > wire for N beyond 2 nIdeal up to N1, a larger closed log-chain; day065 has the margins: tightest log10(N1/N2) = 0.094 at (1e3, 1/200), so the extension is numerically robust). The EM class remains totally exhausted - 0267 adds the range form, not a new class.
content.named_next_fires: (i) WIRE-CROSSING EXTENSION (the 0266 named next fire, now partially consumed): a lower bound on wallLo(N) beyond the 2 nIdeal cap - wallLo(N) = (1/2)N^{-sigma} - t2(N) - t3(N) vs wire as a closed log/rpow equation in (t, d0, N) - proving wallLo(N) > wire for N in (2 nIdeal, N1] in body (the day065 N1 crossing, in closed form: N1 = the wire crossing). (ii) ROUTE (b) NON-EM: a direct-|zeta| bound above tPT2 - the terminal face itself, research. (iii) ROUTE (a): board conveyor (external).
